// MattSkills 面板应用(bundle-0.txt 的源):列表 tracer 的渲染与桥调用。
// 纯脚本无 import(资源通道只搬文本,拼接后以 <script> 注入执行),经 window.MattSkillsPanel.boot
// 交给引导页/测试架驱动。对宿主只有两个依赖:client(ext-apps 桥)与 doc(DOM)。
// 类名命名空间 ms-(M1 基础卡面;完整 PixelCards 色卡体系是工单 04,届时换 cd- 体系)。
"use strict";
(function () {
  // ---- 文案(M1 中文内联,键名按上游 copy 词表组织,为 M3 配置化留缝) ----
  var COPY = {
    loading: "正在加载看板…",
    loadFail: "看板加载失败",
    emptyTitle: "还没有工单",
    emptyBody0: "此工作区还没有 .scratch/ 工单目录。运行 ",
    emptySetup: "/setup-matt-pocock-skills",
    emptyMid: " 初始化,或让 agent 用 ",
    emptyTickets: "/to-tickets",
    emptyEnd: " 拆解规格。",
    emptyHint: "生成工单后,本页签会展示任务看板。",
    boardTitle: "任务看板",
    stateOpen: "在办",
    stateClosed: "已关闭",
    markClaimed: "已认领",
    markBlocked: "被阻塞",
  };

  // 九条计数口径:顺序即胶囊条从左到右;前三枚带 KPI 色值(list-page.md KPI 行:
  // 可接 #4ade80 / 占用 #f0883e / 已关闭 #52525b)。
  var PILLS = [
    { key: "frontier", label: "可接", color: "#4ade80" },
    { key: "open", label: "进行中" },
    { key: "occupied", label: "占用", color: "#f0883e" },
    { key: "claimed", label: "已认领" },
    { key: "blocked", label: "被阻塞" },
    { key: "bug", label: "故障" },
    { key: "triage", label: "诊断" },
    { key: "closed", label: "已关闭", color: "#52525b" },
    { key: "total", label: "全部" },
  ];

  // 内置默认标签色表(上游 src/tracker/rooms/markdown/index.ts defaultLabelPalette 的直拷,
  // 全仓唯一出处;票面既不在色表也没有自带色时回灰 cccccc)。
  var LABEL_COLORS = {
    "bug": "d73a4a",
    "needs-triage": "fbca04",
    "needs-info": "5319e7",
    "ready-for-agent": "0e8a16",
    "ready-for-human": "b60205",
    "wontfix": "ffffff",
    "wayfinder:map": "8b5cf6",
    "wayfinder:research": "0ea5e9",
    "wayfinder:prototype": "f59e0b",
    "wayfinder:grilling": "9d7cd8",
    "wayfinder:task": "10b981",
  };
  function labelColorOf(name) {
    return LABEL_COLORS[name] || "cccccc";
  }

  // ---- 小工具 ----
  function el(doc, tag, cls, text) {
    var n = doc.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) n.className = cls;
    if (text !== undefined && text !== null) n.textContent = String(text);
    return n;
  }
  function textOf(res) {
    if (res && Array.isArray(res.content)) {
      for (var c of res.content) if (c && c.type === "text" && c.text) return c.text;
    }
    return "";
  }
  /** 卡的显示编号:#effort/编号(根级无目录前缀);退化身份的 key 已带目录前缀,不重复拼。 */
  function numberText(row) {
    var key = String(row.key || "");
    if (key.includes("/")) return "#" + key;
    return "#" + (row.effortId ? row.effortId + "/" : "") + key;
  }
  /** 组内排序主键:编号尾数字(退化身份取文件名段里的数字,取不到按 0)。 */
  function numOf(row) {
    var m = /(\d+)\s*$/.exec(String(row.key || ""));
    return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0;
  }
  /** 三段排序(list-page.md):探索地图 → 规格 → 普通票;组内编号升序,标题/目录兜底。 */
  function sortRows(rows) {
    var rank = { map: 0, spec: 1 };
    return rows.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      var ka = rank[a.type] ?? 2;
      var kb = rank[b.type] ?? 2;
      if (ka !== kb) return ka - kb;
      var d = numOf(a) - numOf(b);
      if (d) return d;
      d = String(a.title || "").localeCompare(String(b.title || ""));
      if (d) return d;
      return String(a.effortId || "").localeCompare(String(b.effortId || ""));
    });
  }
  /** 占用口径(与 computeCounts 同义):被 open 阻塞(断链按安全阻塞)。 */
  function isBlocked(row) {
    return Array.isArray(row.blockedBy) && row.blockedBy.some(function (r) {
      return !r || r.state !== "closed";
    });
  }
  function isClaimed(row) {
    return Array.isArray(row.assignees) && row.assignees.length > 0;
  }

  // ---- 状态视图 ----
  function renderLoading(doc, root) {
    var app = el(doc, "div", "ms-app");
    app.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-state ms-loading", COPY.loading));
    root.replaceChildren(app);
  }
  function renderError(doc, root, err) {
    var app = el(doc, "div", "ms-app");
    var box = el(doc, "div", "ms-state ms-error");
    box.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-error-title", COPY.loadFail));
    box.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-error-detail", (err && err.message) || String(err)));
    app.append(box);
    root.replaceChildren(app);
  }
  /** 空工作区引导态(延续骨架期文案,指向建卡技能,绝不回演示数据)。 */
  function renderGuide(doc, root) {
    var app = el(doc, "div", "ms-app");
    var box = el(doc, "div", "ms-state ms-empty");
    box.append(el(doc, "h1", "ms-empty-title", COPY.emptyTitle));
    var p = el(doc, "p", "ms-empty-body");
    p.append(COPY.emptyBody0);
    p.append(el(doc, "code", null, COPY.emptySetup));
    p.append(COPY.emptyMid);
    p.append(el(doc, "code", null, COPY.emptyTickets));
    p.append(COPY.emptyEnd);
    box.append(p);
    box.append(el(doc, "p", "ms-empty-hint", COPY.emptyHint));
    app.append(box);
    root.replaceChildren(app);
  }

  // ---- 计数胶囊条 + 卡片行 ----
  function renderCountsBar(doc, counts) {
    var bar = el(doc, "div", "ms-counts");
    for (var p of PILLS) {
      var pill = el(doc, "span", "ms-pill" + (p.color ? " ms-kpi" : ""), p.label + " " + (counts[p.key] ?? 0));
      pill.setAttribute("data-key", p.key);
      if (p.color) {
        pill.setAttribute("data-color", p.color);
        pill.style.color = p.color;
        pill.style.borderColor = p.color;
      }
      bar.append(pill);
    }
    return bar;
  }
  function renderRow(doc, row) {
    var cls = "ms-row ms-kind-" + (row.type || "issue") + " " + (row.state === "closed" ? "ms-closed" : "ms-open");
    if (isClaimed(row)) cls += " ms-claimed";
    if (isBlocked(row)) cls += " ms-blocked";
    var r = el(doc, "div", cls);
    r.setAttribute("data-num", numberText(row));

    var head = el(doc, "div", "ms-row-head");
    var num = el(doc, "span", "ms-num", numberText(row));
    num.setAttribute("title", numberText(row));
    head.append(num);
    var title = el(doc, "span", "ms-title", row.title || "");
    title.setAttribute("title", row.title || "");
    head.append(title);
    head.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-state-chip", row.state === "closed" ? COPY.stateClosed : COPY.stateOpen));
    r.append(head);

    var foot = el(doc, "div", "ms-row-foot");
    var tags = el(doc, "div", "ms-tags");
    var labels = Array.isArray(row.labels) ? row.labels : [];
    for (var lab of labels) {
      if (!lab || !lab.name) continue;
      var hex = "#" + labelColorOf(lab.name);
      var chip = el(doc, "span", "ms-label");
      var dot = el(doc, "span", "ms-label-dot");
      dot.setAttribute("data-color", hex);
      dot.style.background = hex;
      chip.append(dot);
      chip.append(lab.name);
      tags.append(chip);
    }
    foot.append(tags);
    var marks = el(doc, "div", "ms-marks");
    if (isClaimed(row)) marks.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-mark ms-mark-claimed", COPY.markClaimed));
    if (isBlocked(row)) marks.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-mark ms-mark-blocked", COPY.markBlocked));
    foot.append(marks);
    r.append(foot);
    r.addEventListener("click", function () {
      openDetail(row);
    });
    return r;
  }
  function renderBoard(doc, root, rows, counts) {
    var app = el(doc, "div", "ms-app ms-board");
    var head = el(doc, "div", "ms-head");
    head.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-head-title", COPY.boardTitle));
    app.append(head);
    app.append(renderCountsBar(doc, counts));
    var list = el(doc, "div", "ms-rows");
    for (var row of sortRows(rows)) list.append(renderRow(doc, row));
    app.append(list);
    root.replaceChildren(app);
  }

  // ---- 视图状态:进详情后列表数据留在缓存,返回时原样重渲染(筛选状态落位在此) ----
  var st = { client: null, doc: null, root: null, rows: [], counts: {} };
  function openDetail(row) {
    if (!window.MattSkillsDetail) return;
    window.MattSkillsDetail.open({
      client: st.client,
      doc: st.doc,
      root: st.root,
      row: row,
      onBack: function () {
        renderBoard(st.doc, st.root, st.rows, st.counts);
      },
    });
  }

  // ---- 入口 ----
  async function boot(opts) {
    var client = opts.client;
    var doc = opts.doc;
    var root = opts.root;
    renderLoading(doc, root);
    try {
      var results = await Promise.all([
        client.callTool("deck_issue_list", {}),
        client.callTool("deck_issue_counts", {}),
      ]);
      var list = results[0];
      var counts = results[1];
      if (list && list.isError) throw Error(textOf(list) || "deck_issue_list 失败");
      if (counts && counts.isError) throw Error(textOf(counts) || "deck_issue_counts 失败");
      var listSc = (list && list.structuredContent) || {};
      var countsSc = (counts && counts.structuredContent) || {};
      if (countsSc.empty || listSc.empty) {
        renderGuide(doc, root);
        return;
      }
      st.client = client;
      st.doc = doc;
      st.root = root;
      st.rows = Array.isArray(listSc.rows) ? listSc.rows : [];
      st.counts = countsSc.counts || {};
      renderBoard(doc, root, st.rows, st.counts);
    } catch (e) {
      renderError(doc, root, e);
    }
  }

  window.MattSkillsPanel = { boot: boot };
})();

// MattSkills 详情视图(工单 05):列表行点击后的只读详情页。
// 纯脚本无 import,与 app.js 由 build.mjs 拼进同一 bundle;app.js 在行点击时经
// window.MattSkillsDetail.open 调进来。结构对照上游 IssueDetail 的 M1 子集
// (port-notes/detail-page.md):粘性顶栏(返回+编号+标题,长文按阶梯折叠) → 头部(编号+标题)
// → 元行(状态/标签/认领/日期) → 正文(三态 + markdown 基础渲染) → 评论时间线 → 只读提示。
// 取数口径(#693):正文与评论一律以 deck_issue_get 那次取数为准;列表行只做轻量预览(元行)。
"use strict";
(function () {
  // ---- 文案(M1 中文内联,键名按上游 copy 词表组织) ----
  var COPY = {
    back: "返回列表",
    descTitle: "描述",
    bodyLoading: "加载中…",
    noBody: "无描述",
    bodyError: "详情加载失败",
    retry: "重试",
    getBadShape: "deck_issue_get 应答缺卡数据",
    commentsLoading: "评论 · 加载中",
    commentsNotYet: "评论 · 还没拿到",
    claimed: "已认领",
    stateOpen: "在办",
    stateClosed: "已关闭",
    readOnlyHint: "只读视图:改动请直接编辑 .scratch 卡片文件",
  };

  // 上游 IssueDetailComments 的显示切片页大小(detail-page.md §2):
  // 标题计数用全量,时间线一次只铺 50 条,超出给「显示其余」。
  var COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE = 50;

  // 元数据字段行(可见写法,可加粗;围栏代码块内不算):这些进元行,不进描述。
  var FIELD_LINE_RE = /^(?:\*\*)?(?:status|labels?|label|type|blocked\s+by|assignees|close\s+reason)(?:\*\*)?\s*[:\uFF1A]/i;

  // ---- 小工具(与 app.js 各持一份:bundle 段落平级,不共享闭包) ----
  function el(doc, tag, cls, text) {
    var n = doc.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) n.className = cls;
    if (text !== undefined && text !== null) n.textContent = String(text);
    return n;
  }
  function textOf(res) {
    if (res && Array.isArray(res.content)) {
      for (var c of res.content) if (c && c.type === "text" && c.text) return c.text;
    }
    return "";
  }
  /** 卡的显示编号:#effort/编号;退化身份的 key 已带目录前缀,不重复拼。 */
  function numberText(row) {
    var key = String(row.key || "");
    if (key.includes("/")) return "#" + key;
    return "#" + (row.effortId ? row.effortId + "/" : "") + key;
  }
  /** get 寻址参数:退化身份原样;正常票补工作单元前缀,免得同号被目录序抢走。 */
  function getArgOf(row) {
    var key = String(row.key || "");
    if (key.includes("/")) return key;
    return row.effortId ? row.effortId + "/" + key : key;
  }
  function labelColorOf(name) {
    return LABEL_COLORS[name] || "cccccc";
  }
  // 内置默认标签色表,与 app.js 同源直拷(上游 defaultLabelPalette)。
  var LABEL_COLORS = {
    "bug": "d73a4a",
    "needs-triage": "fbca04",
    "needs-info": "5319e7",
    "ready-for-agent": "0e8a16",
    "ready-for-human": "b60205",
    "wontfix": "ffffff",
    "wayfinder:map": "8b5cf6",
    "wayfinder:research": "0ea5e9",
    "wayfinder:prototype": "f59e0b",
    "wayfinder:grilling": "9d7cd8",
    "wayfinder:task": "10b981",
  };

  // ---- 描述抽取:整卡 markdown 里去掉标题/字段行/隐藏注释/Comments 段,剩下的才是「描述」 ----
  function descriptionOf(raw) {
    var s = String(raw || "");
    // 去 ## Comments 段(切分口径与 cards.mjs 的评论解析一致:段到下一个 H2 为止)
    var cm = /^\s*##\s*Comments\s*$/im.exec(s);
    if (cm) {
      var after = s.slice(cm.index + cm[0].length);
      var nextH2 = /^\s*##\s+/m.exec(after);
      s = s.slice(0, cm.index) + (nextH2 ? after.slice(nextH2.index) : "");
    }
    var out = [];
    var fenced = false;
    var h1Dropped = false;
    for (var line of s.split("\n")) {
      if (/^[ \t]*(```|~~~)/.test(line)) {
        fenced = !fenced;
        out.push(line);
        continue;
      }
      if (fenced) {
        out.push(line);
        continue;
      }
      var t = line.trim();
      if (/^<!--.*-->$/.test(t)) continue; // 文件头隐藏注释(DSH-*)整行去
      if (!h1Dropped && /^#{1,6}\s+/.test(t)) {
        h1Dropped = true; // 首个标题就是卡标题,头部已展示
        continue;
      }
      if (FIELD_LINE_RE.test(t)) continue; // 元数据字段行进元行
      out.push(line);
    }
    return out.join("\n").trim();
  }

  // ---- markdown 基础渲染(自写不引库):标题/列表/围栏代码块/粗斜体;全部走 DOM 构建,不吃 HTML ----
  var INLINE_RE = /\*\*(.+?)\*\*|\*(.+?)\*/g;
  function inlineNodes(doc, s) {
    var out = [];
    var last = 0;
    var m;
    INLINE_RE.lastIndex = 0;
    while ((m = INLINE_RE.exec(s))) {
      if (m.index > last) out.push(s.slice(last, m.index));
      if (m[1] !== undefined) out.push(el(doc, "strong", null, m[1]));
      else out.push(el(doc, "em", null, m[2]));
      last = m.index + m[0].length;
    }
    if (last < s.length) out.push(s.slice(last));
    return out;
  }
  function appendInline(doc, target, s) {
    target.append.apply(target, inlineNodes(doc, String(s || "")));
  }
  /** 块级:围栏代码块 → pre>code;#/##/… → h1..h6;- / * 连续行 → ul;N. 连续行 → ol;其余 → 段落。 */
  function mdNodes(doc, text) {
    var out = [];
    var lines = String(text || "").split("\n");
    var i = 0;
    while (i < lines.length) {
      var t = lines[i].trim();
      if (!t) {
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (/^(```|~~~)/.test(t)) {
        var buf = [];
        i++;
        while (i < lines.length && !/^[ \t]*(```|~~~)/.test(lines[i])) {
          buf.push(lines[i]);
          i++;
        }
        i++; // 收尾围栏
        var pre = el(doc, "pre", "ms-md-pre");
        pre.append(el(doc, "code", null, buf.join("\n")));
        out.push(pre);
        continue;
      }
      var h = /^(#{1,6})\s+(.*)$/.exec(t);
      if (h) {
        var hn = el(doc, "h" + h[1].length, "ms-md-h");
        appendInline(doc, hn, h[2]);
        out.push(hn);
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      var li;
      if (/^[-*]\s+/.test(t)) {
        var ul = el(doc, "ul", "ms-md-list");
        while (i < lines.length) {
          var um = /^[-*]\s+(.*)$/.exec(lines[i].trim());
          if (!um) break;
          li = el(doc, "li");
          appendInline(doc, li, um[1]);
          ul.append(li);
          i++;
        }
        out.push(ul);
        continue;
      }
      if (/^\d+[.]\s+/.test(t)) {
        var ol = el(doc, "ol", "ms-md-list");
        while (i < lines.length) {
          var om = /^\d+[.]\s+(.*)$/.exec(lines[i].trim());
          if (!om) break;
          li = el(doc, "li");
          appendInline(doc, li, om[1]);
          ol.append(li);
          i++;
        }
        out.push(ol);
        continue;
      }
      // 段落:连续普通行一段(soft-break 交给 CSS pre-wrap 保住)
      var buf2 = [];
      while (i < lines.length) {
        var pt = lines[i].trim();
        if (
          !pt || /^(```|~~~)/.test(pt) || /^#{1,6}\s+/.test(pt) ||
          /^[-*]\s+/.test(pt) || /^\d+[.]\s+/.test(pt)
        ) break;
        buf2.push(pt);
        i++;
      }
      out.push(el(doc, "p", "ms-md-p", buf2.join("\n")));
    }
    return out;
  }

  // ---- 顶栏折叠(issueDetailFold 口径,detail-page.md §3) ----
  // 阶梯:按元素顺序(上游五元素 back/crumb/snapshot/primary/newSession;M1 顶栏是
  // back/编号/标题三元素,同算法),每个元素按其字数逐级 push({el, n:1..len})。
  function foldLadderOf(elems) {
    var steps = [];
    for (var e of elems) {
      for (var n = 1; n <= e.text.length; n++) steps.push({ el: e.el, n: n });
    }
    return steps;
  }
  /** fits 判定:scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth+1;测量环境缺失(桩/离屏)视作放得下,不折。 */
  function foldFits(bar) {
    var sw = bar.scrollWidth;
    var cw = bar.clientWidth;
    if (typeof sw !== "number" || typeof cw !== "number") return true;
    return sw <= cw + 1;
  }
  /** 折叠机:先全量复位(data-full 兜底),不 fit 则 tier=1 逐档试;尾部逐字裁,不补省略号。 */
  function applyDetailFold(bar, elems) {
    if (!bar || !elems.length) return;
    for (var e of elems) {
      e.el.setAttribute("data-full", e.text);
      e.el.textContent = e.text;
    }
    if (foldFits(bar)) return;
    var steps = foldLadderOf(elems);
    for (var tier = 1; tier <= steps.length; tier++) {
      var drop = new Map();
      for (var k = 0; k < tier && k < steps.length; k++) drop.set(steps[k].el, steps[k].n);
      for (var e2 of elems) {
        var d = drop.get(e2.el) || 0;
        e2.el.textContent = e2.text.slice(0, e2.text.length - d);
      }
      void bar.offsetWidth; // 强制重排一次再量
      if (foldFits(bar)) return;
    }
  }
  var foldCtx = null; // 最近一次详情顶栏的折叠上下文
  var foldObserver = null;
  var foldBound = false;
  function refold() {
    if (foldCtx) applyDetailFold(foldCtx.bar, foldCtx.elems);
  }
  function bindFoldOnce() {
    if (foldBound) return;
    foldBound = true;
    if (typeof window.addEventListener === "function") window.addEventListener("resize", refold);
    if (typeof document !== "undefined" && document.fonts && document.fonts.ready && typeof document.fonts.ready.then === "function") {
      document.fonts.ready.then(refold);
    }
    if (typeof window.ResizeObserver === "function") foldObserver = new window.ResizeObserver(refold);
  }

  // ---- 详情状态与取数 ----
  var SEQ = 0;
  var cur = null; // {seq, client, doc, row, refs:{bodyBox,cmtTitle,cmtList}}

  function renderMeta(doc, row) {
    var meta = el(doc, "div", "ms-meta");
    meta.append(
      el(
        doc,
        "span",
        "ms-state-chip " + (row.state === "closed" ? "ms-chip-closed" : "ms-chip-open"),
        row.state === "closed" ? COPY.stateClosed : COPY.stateOpen
      )
    );
    var labels = Array.isArray(row.labels) ? row.labels : [];
    for (var lab of labels) {
      if (!lab || !lab.name) continue;
      var hex = "#" + labelColorOf(lab.name);
      var chip = el(doc, "span", "ms-label");
      var dot = el(doc, "span", "ms-label-dot");
      dot.setAttribute("data-color", hex);
      dot.style.background = hex;
      chip.append(dot);
      chip.append(lab.name);
      meta.append(chip);
    }
    var assignees = Array.isArray(row.assignees) ? row.assignees : [];
    for (var a of assignees) {
      if (a && a.login) meta.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-assignee", "@" + a.login));
      else meta.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-assignee", COPY.claimed)); // claimed 但没记名字
    }
    var updated = String(row.updatedAt || "").slice(0, 10);
    var created = String(row.createdAt || "").slice(0, 10);
    if (updated) meta.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-meta-date", "· 更新 " + updated));
    if (created) meta.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-meta-date", "· 创建 " + created));
    return meta;
  }

  function commentItem(doc, c) {
    var it = el(doc, "div", "ms-cmt-item");
    var head = el(doc, "div", "ms-cmt-head");
    head.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-cmt-login", "@" + ((c && c.author && c.author.login) || "ghost")));
    var date = String((c && c.createdAt) || "").slice(0, 10);
    if (date) head.append(el(doc, "span", "ms-cmt-date", date));
    it.append(head);
    var body = el(doc, "div", "ms-cmt-body");
    var nodes = mdNodes(doc, (c && c.body) || "");
    body.append.apply(body, nodes);
    it.append(body);
    return it;
  }

  function renderCard(card) {
    var refs = cur.refs;
    var doc = cur.doc;
    // 正文三态之三:取到了才有资格说「无描述」
    var desc = descriptionOf(card.body);
    if (desc) {
      var nodes = mdNodes(doc, desc);
      refs.bodyBox.replaceChildren.apply(refs.bodyBox, nodes);
    } else {
      refs.bodyBox.replaceChildren(el(doc, "div", "ms-body-empty", COPY.noBody));
    }
    // 评论时间线:计数以详情为准;未取到前不许报「评论 (0)」
    var comments = Array.isArray(card.comments) ? card.comments : [];
    refs.cmtTitle.textContent = "评论 (" + comments.length + ")";
    refs.cmtList.replaceChildren();
    var shown = Math.min(comments.length, COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE);
    for (var i = 0; i < shown; i++) refs.cmtList.append(commentItem(doc, comments[i]));
    if (comments.length > shown) {
      var more = el(doc, "button", "ms-cmt-more");
      more.setAttribute("type", "button");
      var update = function () {
        more.textContent = "显示其余 " + (comments.length - shown) + " 条";
      };
      update();
      more.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var next = Math.min(comments.length, shown + COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE);
        for (var j = shown; j < next; j++) refs.cmtList.append(commentItem(doc, comments[j]));
        shown = next;
        if (shown >= comments.length) more.remove();
        else update();
      });
      refs.cmtList.append(more);
    }
  }

  function renderFail(seq, msg) {
    var refs = cur.refs;
    var doc = cur.doc;
    var box = el(doc, "div", "ms-body-error");
    box.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-body-error-title", COPY.bodyError));
    box.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-error-detail", msg || ""));
    var retry = el(doc, "button", "ms-retry", COPY.retry);
    retry.setAttribute("type", "button");
    retry.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (!cur || cur.seq !== seq) return;
      var s2 = ++SEQ;
      cur.seq = s2;
      refs.bodyBox.replaceChildren(el(doc, "div", "ms-body-loading", COPY.bodyLoading));
      refs.cmtTitle.textContent = COPY.commentsLoading;
      refs.cmtList.replaceChildren();
      fetchDetail(s2);
    });
    box.append(retry);
    refs.bodyBox.replaceChildren(box);
    refs.cmtTitle.textContent = COPY.commentsNotYet;
    refs.cmtList.replaceChildren();
  }

  function fetchDetail(seq) {
    cur.client.callTool("deck_issue_get", { key: getArgOf(cur.row) }).then(
      function (res) {
        if (!cur || cur.seq !== seq) return; // 已返回列表/已重试:迟到应答丢弃
        if (res && res.isError) return renderFail(seq, textOf(res));
        var card = res && res.structuredContent && res.structuredContent.card;
        if (!card || typeof card.body !== "string") return renderFail(seq, COPY.getBadShape);
        renderCard(card);
      },
      function (err) {
        if (!cur || cur.seq !== seq) return;
        renderFail(seq, (err && err.message) || String(err));
      }
    );
  }

  /** 入口:app.js 行点击调进来。shell 即刻渲染(元行用列表行轻量预览),正文/评论等 get 回来。 */
  function open(opts) {
    var client = opts.client;
    var doc = opts.doc;
    var row = opts.row;
    var seq = ++SEQ;
    cur = { seq: seq, client: client, doc: doc, row: row, refs: null };
    var num = numberText(row);
    var title = String(row.title || "");

    var app = el(doc, "div", "ms-app ms-detail");
    // 粘性顶栏:返回 + 编号 + 标题(折叠阶梯的三元素,各自留 data-full 底稿)
    var bar = el(doc, "div", "ms-topbar");
    bar.setAttribute("data-detail-topbar", "1");
    var back = el(doc, "button", "ms-back", COPY.back);
    back.setAttribute("type", "button");
    back.setAttribute("data-full", COPY.back);
    var bnum = el(doc, "span", "ms-topbar-num", num);
    bnum.setAttribute("data-full", num);
    bnum.setAttribute("title", num);
    var btitle = el(doc, "span", "ms-topbar-title", title);
    btitle.setAttribute("data-full", title);
    btitle.setAttribute("title", title);
    bar.append(back, bnum, btitle);
    app.append(bar);
    // 头部:编号徽标 + 标题(全文)
    var head = el(doc, "div", "ms-detail-head");
    var hnum = el(doc, "span", "ms-num", num);
    hnum.setAttribute("title", num);
    var htitle = el(doc, "span", "ms-detail-title", title);
    htitle.setAttribute("title", title);
    head.append(hnum, htitle);
    app.append(head);
    app.append(renderMeta(doc, row));
    // 正文块(三态容器)
    var sec = el(doc, "div", "ms-body-sec");
    sec.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-sec-title", COPY.descTitle));
    var bodyBox = el(doc, "div", "ms-body");
    bodyBox.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-body-loading", COPY.bodyLoading));
    sec.append(bodyBox);
    app.append(sec);
    // 评论时间线
    var cmt = el(doc, "div", "ms-comments");
    var cmtTitle = el(doc, "div", "ms-comments-title", COPY.commentsLoading);
    var cmtList = el(doc, "div", "ms-cmt-list");
    cmt.append(cmtTitle, cmtList);
    app.append(cmt);
    // 底部只读提示
    app.append(el(doc, "div", "ms-readonly", COPY.readOnlyHint));
    opts.root.replaceChildren(app);
    cur.refs = { bodyBox: bodyBox, cmtTitle: cmtTitle, cmtList: cmtList };

    // 折叠:本顶栏挂进上下文,resize/fonts/RO 重算
    bindFoldOnce();
    if (foldObserver) {
      foldObserver.disconnect();
      foldObserver.observe(bar);
    }
    foldCtx = {
      bar: bar,
      elems: [
        { el: back, text: COPY.back },
        { el: bnum, text: num },
        { el: btitle, text: title },
      ],
    };
    applyDetailFold(bar, foldCtx.elems);

    back.addEventListener("click", function () {
      close();
      if (typeof opts.onBack === "function") opts.onBack();
    });

    fetchDetail(seq);
  }

  function close() {
    SEQ++; // 迟到应答作废
    cur = null;
    foldCtx = null;
    if (foldObserver) foldObserver.disconnect();
  }

  window.MattSkillsDetail = { open: open };
})();
